text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ

words.gloss_range: resumptive or connective opening particle that carries the prior discourse into a fresh third-person report
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuity with a changed register: after the prior guided-knowing frame (22:54), the sentence resumes with a third-person report about the deniers. The small visible particle keeps the boundary connected, and with the next light negative particle it delays lexical weight until the heavier negated-continuance frame begins.

topics.headline: resumptive boundary with register shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah continues the prior movement while shifting from direct guidance-language into a distanced report about deniers.
topics.reason: The opening particle is compatible with resumption or coordination, and the local clause begins a new third-person report rather than a detached topic.

topics.headline: clipped onset into stative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears two light particles before the heavier negated continuance verb, so the ayah delays lexical weight until the persistence frame arrives.
topics.reason: The form is an independent particle and the sound-row payoff remains local to the opening sequence.

words.gloss_range: declarative negation scoped over the defective imperfect verb, producing non-cessation rather than prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is declarative negation, not a prohibition. Its visible polarity arrives before the cessation verb, so the phrase does not deny doubt directly; it denies cessation and thereby makes their doubt an ongoing, arrested state that awaits an outside endpoint.

topics.headline: declarative negation of cessation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the wording reports an ongoing condition, not a command, and that the negation creates persistence by negating cessation.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support identify the particle as verbal negation over the copular imperfective construction.

topics.headline: visible polarity before stasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears polarity before the cessation-root arrives, making the first half of the ayah feel like arrested duration.
topics.reason: The independent negative particle is locally visible and prepares the long stasis half before the endpoint particle.

words.gloss_range: negated defective imperfect: they do not cease, with the state predicate supplied by the following prepositional phrase
words.root_gloss_range: cessation, departure from a state, removal, and displacement; the local Form I imperfect under negation selects non-cessation and non-departure, not causative removal
words.prose: {{ar:يَزَالُ}} ({{tr:yazālu}}) carries the cessation-root under negation, so persistence is built through inversion: they do not cease and do not depart from the state named after it. As a defective verb, it requires the following prepositional predicate, making doubt the condition that contains the group until the endpoint particle introduces an arrival that displaces the stasis from outside.

topics.headline: non-cessation as persistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that persistence is stronger because it is phrased as refused cessation rather than as a simple verb of remaining.
topics.reason: The imperfective root is locally negated by {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), and the construction sustains duration until the endpoint.

topics.headline: defective verb frames doubt as state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees doubt as the predicate-state that contains the group, not as a single action they perform.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the following prepositional phrase as the predicate of the defective verb.

topics.headline: departure image under local limits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a root of ceasing or departing now describes people who do not depart from doubt, while arrival later displaces the state.
topics.reason: The broader root family includes removal and displacement, but the local Form I imperfect with {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) selects non-cessation rather than causative removal.

topics.headline: stasis answered by arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from arrested stasis to an arrival that ends the state from outside.
topics.reason: The local syntax places the z-w-l construction before the two arrival clauses, so the inter-root relation is structural as well as lexical.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun forming a definite, extensible subject class completed by the following verb
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not finish the subject by itself; it waits for the following perfect denial verb to define the group. The ayah therefore names a definite but repeatable class, those characterized by denial, before assigning them the predicate of persistent doubt.

topics.headline: relative subject class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is class-shaped: the people are defined by an action rather than named as individuals.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as the masculine plural relative pronoun and attachment evidence places it as the subject of the defective verb.

topics.headline: subject completed by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the grammar delay subject completion until denial becomes part of the group's identity.
topics.reason: The relative clause is syntactically forced and the plural agreement binds the pronoun to the following verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural defining the relative subject through established disbelief or rejection, with no expressed object
words.root_gloss_range: covering or concealing, denial, rejection, and ingratitude; local Form I perfect selects responsible denial rather than causative making-disbelieve or remedial expiation
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) completes the relative subject by making denial an established act with present consequences. The covering/rejection field makes the following doubt morally charged rather than neutral uncertainty, while the Form I plural keeps responsibility with the group and leaves the object of disbelief compressed.

topics.headline: perfect denial defines the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disbelief as the act that defines the subject before their state of doubt is described.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb is inside the relative clause and carries no expressed object, so it functions as subject definition.

topics.headline: covering image with moral valence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubt follows a charged act of covering or rejection, not an innocent absence of information.
topics.reason: The wider covering and ingratitude field informs the local denial, while the local verb still selects disbelief rather than every derivative branch.

topics.headline: plural Form I responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a collective responsible act, not a group made into deniers by another agent or labeled by an intensive adjective.
topics.reason: The local surface is Form I perfect plural and not a causative or intensive adjectival form.

topics.headline: denial answered by punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening denial is answered later in the same ayah by arriving punishment and in the nearby verdict (22:57).
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence supports the k-f-r and ʿ-dh-b pairing, and the local ayah places both poles in sequence.

topics.headline: belief boundary reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary turn from knowledge and belief in the previous ayah (22:54) to a distanced category of deniers.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give concrete local contrast with the prior ayah's recognition frame.

words.gloss_range: preposition of containment governing the doubt noun and forming the predicate of the defective verb
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes doubt the space-like predicate of the defective verb: the deniers are not merely performing doubt but are located inside it. Its job is distinct from the later preposition-plus-suffix, because {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) contains the state while the later phrase specifies the referent of that doubt after denial has already defined the subject.

topics.headline: predicate containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees doubt as an enclosure the group inhabits, not a passing mental act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the predicate and the governed noun the content of that predicate.

topics.headline: containment distinct from specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two different prepositional jobs: containment in doubt first, specification of its referent second.
topics.reason: The local attachments separate {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governing the doubt noun from {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) governing the suffix referent.

topics.headline: predicate after subject definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the order name denial first, then place that defined group inside doubt.
topics.reason: The word order places the prepositional predicate after the relative subject has been completed.

words.gloss_range: indefinite abstract noun for agitated, contentious doubt governed by the containment preposition
words.root_gloss_range: doubt, disputation, mutual uncertainty, and a physical pulling or milking image; the local noun selects agitated doubt as a state, not an active disputing verb
words.prose: {{ar:مِرْيَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:miryatin}}) is the contained state: indefinite, genitive, abstract, and not stabilized as a named doctrine. The word does not present calm uncertainty; its rare nominal form, root family, and fiʿla shape make the doubt restless and contentious, a state that is pulled on repeatedly while the negated-continuance construction keeps it extended before the Hour-arrival field.

topics.headline: indefinite state inside containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the doubt as an indefinite state inside the predicate, not as a named or stabilized doctrine.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and indefinite by tanwīn.

topics.headline: agitated doubt rather than neutral uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah depicts restless, agitated doubt rather than neutral lack of information.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports mirya as charged doubt, while the local noun keeps it a state rather than an active dispute.

topics.headline: pulling and disputation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels doubt as repeated mental pulling and contention, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as doubt.
topics.reason: The family images are relevant as pressure, but the local abstract noun does not activate a literal milking or finite disputing action.

topics.headline: rare noun near Hour uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare nominal doubt-form is placed before the Hour's arrival, focusing the state itself.
topics.reason: The distribution and local sequence support the connection between agitated doubt and the later Hour-arrival.

topics.headline: certainty reversed into agitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior certainty frame (22:54) reverse into a trapped, restless doubt-state.
topics.reason: The boundary and synthesis rows combine the local container grammar, persistent verb, and prior-ayah contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus masculine singular suffix specifying the referent or source of the doubt, most locally tied to the prior truth referent
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) compresses the relation and its antecedent into one word. After the preceding phrase has made doubt a container-state, {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) specifies what that doubt concerns or from where it arises; the masculine singular suffix keeps the prior truth referent from 22:54 most available without spelling it out again, so the same referent receives opposite epistemic stances across the boundary.

topics.headline: doubt specified by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah first places the group inside doubt, then points that doubt toward a prior referent.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the preposition and suffix to the doubt noun as its complement.

topics.headline: truth referent most available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what the prior ayah recognized as truth (22:54) becomes the referent about which the deniers remain in doubt.
topics.reason: The masculine singular suffix fits the prior truth referent strongly, while the pronoun still leaves broader prior discourse structurally possible.

topics.headline: about-it and from-it relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both relation pressures in view: doubt may be about the referent and may arise from their encounter with it.
topics.reason: The preposition can mark specification or source, but local syntax only requires a complement relation to the doubt noun.

topics.headline: compressed boundary reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same prior referent carried across the boundary without being re-named, which sharpens the opposite epistemic stances.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix compresses relation and antecedent, preserving boundary dependence.

words.gloss_range: temporal endpoint particle governing the prospective arrival clauses and pivoting from persistent doubt to rupture
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) is the hinge of the ayah. It measures how long the deniers remain in doubt, not why they doubt, and then turns the sentence from stasis to two prospective endpoints: the Hour coming suddenly or the punishment of a barren day coming to them. Its long final sound gives the short hinge audible weight before the first arrival verb.

topics.headline: endpoint over two arrivals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that persistent doubt is grammatically finite: it runs only until the prospective arrival endpoints.
topics.reason: Attachment support says the endpoint contains two alternative arrival clauses, and QAC marks the following verbs as subjunctive after the particle.

topics.headline: endpoint reading over purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the particle as a temporal limit to doubt, not as the purpose for which doubt exists.
topics.reason: The wider particle range includes purpose, but the local negated continuance construction selects endpoint.

topics.headline: pivot from stasis to rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from an ongoing cognitive enclosure to a closed terminus.
topics.reason: The particle divides the local clause into persistent state before it and terminal events after it.

topics.headline: audible hinge weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short hinge receive weight before the first arrival verb.
topics.reason: The form observation is local to the written and recited shape of the endpoint particle.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect subjunctive feminine arrival verb with object suffix, directed at the deniers and agreeing with the Hour
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, reaching, bringing, and giving in other forms; local Form I selects directed arrival, not causative giving
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْتِيَهُمُ}} ({{tr:taʾtiyahumu}}) makes the first endpoint an arrival that reaches the deniers before its subject is even named. The feminine subjunctive form agrees with the following Hour noun, so the Hour is the actor and the group is the recipient; the same arrival-root will return in the next clause with a different subject. The Form I coming frame keeps this as event-agency rather than giving, recalls the Hour-coming claim of 22:7 as directed arrival, and the hamza catch suits the break from doubt to event.

topics.headline: arrival reaches the deniers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deniers as recipients of an event that comes upon them, not agents who control the endpoint.
topics.reason: The object suffix is syntactically forced as the direct object of the arrival verb.

topics.headline: feminine verb locks to the Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can tell from the verb's form that the Hour, not the earlier plural group, is the arriving subject.
topics.reason: The feminine subject agreement and subjunctive after {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) are locally forced.

topics.headline: event agency, not giving frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an abstract temporal event acting on humans, while the broader giving branch remains outside the local Form I arrival.
topics.reason: The root family includes giving in other forms, but this surface is Form I arrival under an event subject.

topics.headline: first half of twin arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears arrival as the constant frame while the arriving entity changes from Hour to punishment.
topics.reason: The same root and suffix pattern recur in the coordinated second arrival clause.

topics.headline: 22:7 Hour-coming made directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Hour's coming stated as fact in 22:7 return here as an arrival directed at the doubters.
topics.reason: The source rows give the concrete same-surah reference and the local form makes the arrival target-bound.

topics.headline: hamza break at rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a catch inside the arrival verb at the point where the sentence turns from doubt to event.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is tied to the local surface and hinge position.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative subject of the first arrival clause: the known decisive Hour, with moment-pressure still felt
words.root_gloss_range: hour, moment, stretch of time, and the technical eschatological Hour; local definiteness and subject role select the known final Hour
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}) resolves the delayed feminine verb as the subject of arrival. Its definiteness presupposes the known Hour rather than any generic hour, with the assimilated article making that familiarity audible, and the ordinary time-unit background keeps the decisive event compressed into a single critical moment. The noun also sits in the coming-and-suddenness cluster that recalls the Hour's coming in 22:7.

topics.headline: delayed subject resolves the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels suspense resolved when the post-verbal noun reveals the Hour as the arriving subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the nominative noun the subject of the preceding feminine verb.

topics.headline: known decisive Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah assumes a recognized decisive Hour, not a newly introduced time.
topics.reason: The definite singular noun functions as the known eschatological subject in the arrival clause.

topics.headline: moment compressed into cosmic terminus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final event named by a word that still carries the pressure of a single moment.
topics.reason: The ordinary hour or moment range survives as pressure, while definiteness and context select the technical eschatological sense.

topics.headline: Hour in sudden-coming cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the Hour with the coming-and-suddenness field, including the earlier same-surah claim that the Hour is coming (22:7).
topics.reason: The local clause joins the Hour to coming and suddenness, and the source row gives the concrete same-surah echo.

topics.headline: definiteness fused in recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears definiteness fused into the noun, reinforcing that this is the familiar Hour.
topics.reason: The assimilated article observation is local to the surface form.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative gerund qualifying the arrival as sudden, without prior warning; live as circumstantial or cognate-manner accusative
words.root_gloss_range: sudden, unexpected, unannounced coming or taking unawares; local Quranic form is gerundial manner, not a finite surprise verb
words.prose: {{ar:بَغْتَةً}} ({{tr:baghtatan}}) seals the first endpoint by defining the Hour's arrival as zero-warning rupture, not mere speed. Its accusative role may be read as circumstance or cognate manner, but either way suddenness belongs to how the coming happens, not to a new actor. The root's Quranic gerundial fixation, the variant pacing, and the stop-fricative-stop texture all keep suddenness as a sharp event-quality attached to arrival.

topics.headline: suddenness as arrival manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees suddenness as the manner of the Hour's coming, not as a separate event or actor.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence leaves ḥāl and cognate-accusative parses live, and both attach the word to the manner of arrival.

topics.headline: anti-warning rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that persistent doubt is not answered by a gradual evidence-loop but by an arrival without warning.
topics.reason: The lexical rows distinguish suddenness from mere speed and place it at the close of the first terminus beat.

topics.headline: gerundial form fixes manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this root functioning as a fixed manner-quality attached to events rather than as an independently narrated action.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence says the root appears in this gerundial role and the local form is an accusative gerund.

topics.headline: variant pacing and impact sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the suddenness through compressed or opened sound-shape without changing the lexical sense.
topics.reason: The accepted variant preserves the suddenness sense while changing acoustic pacing, and the phonetic rows remain tied to the local surface.

topics.headline: coming plus suddenness pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recurrent coming-suddenness pattern realized locally as a sharp first endpoint.
topics.reason: The local word immediately follows the arrival verb and the collocation evidence supports the pairing.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive conjunction coordinating two terminal arrival clauses under the same endpoint scope
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) keeps the endpoint forked. It does not introduce a new subject class; it coordinates the second arrival clause with the first, so the same persistent doubt can terminate in the Hour's sudden arrival or in the punishment of a barren day.

topics.headline: forked endpoint under one scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah preserves two terminal arrivals instead of collapsing Hour and punishment into one appositional phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second arrival clause with the first under the endpoint frame.

topics.headline: alternative with possible inclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the punishment distinct as an alternative while allowing it to be a component or expression of the final Hour.
topics.reason: The local conjunction marks disjunction; broader inclusive possibilities are preserved only as semantic range, not as collapse of the clauses.

topics.headline: visible reset into second arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second arrival frame restart while staying coordinated with the first.
topics.reason: The conjunction is an independent particle before the second ʾ-t-y verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect subjunctive masculine arrival verb with object suffix, coordinated as the second endpoint and agreeing with punishment
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, reaching, bringing, and giving in other forms; local Form I selects directed arrival by punishment
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيَهُمْ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiyahum}}) repeats the directed-arrival frame with the same target group, but the masculine verb signals a new subject, the following punishment noun. The second verb remains under the same prospective endpoint scope, and the repetition creates a twin-arrival structure: the Hour and punishment are distinct arriving agents converging on the same recipients.

topics.headline: masculine agreement marks punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the subject change from the feminine Hour to masculine punishment through the verb form itself.
topics.reason: The masculine verb agrees with the nominative punishment subject and contrasts with the earlier feminine arrival verb.

topics.headline: same target group repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arriving force changes while the affected denier group remains fixed.
topics.reason: The object suffix repeats the same recipient role as in the first arrival verb.

topics.headline: second endpoint remains prospective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the second arrival under the same prospective endpoint frame as the first.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with the first subjunctive arrival after {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}).

topics.headline: punishment becomes arriving force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees punishment not merely as a result but as a force that comes to the deniers.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes punishment the subject of the arrival verb, and the collocation evidence supports the arrival-punishment pairing.

topics.headline: twin terminal agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two arrival clauses as a larger structure, with two agents of rupture aimed at one group.
topics.reason: Repeated ʾ-t-y, fixed recipient suffix, gender shift, and {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) together create the twin-arrival frame.

words.gloss_range: construct-state nominative subject: punishment or torment specified by the following barren-day genitive chain
words.root_gloss_range: torment and punishment, with a wider root paradox including sweetness or fresh water; local noun selects torment while the paradox adds sensory pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابُ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābu}}) is not only what is suffered; grammar makes it the subject that comes, so consequence becomes the force that reaches the deniers and answers the opening denial. Its construct state binds it to the following barren-day phrase, so the punishment is specified through the day it belongs to, while the wider root paradox of sweetness and torment sharpens the sensory reversal without displacing the local punishment sense. The same-surah contrast reverses human control: people hasten punishment in 22:47, but here punishment comes to them.

topics.headline: punishment specified by its day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees punishment identified through the day it belongs to, not as an isolated abstract noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the iḍāfa relation between punishment and the following day.

topics.headline: punishment as arriving actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees consequence become the force that reaches the deniers.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as the subject of the second arrival verb, and its abstract-noun form lets punishment itself act.

topics.headline: sweetness reversed into torment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root family's sweetness-torment paradox as a sensory reversal, while the local noun still means punishment.
topics.reason: The wider root family includes sweet or fresh-water senses, but the local abstract noun selects torment.

topics.headline: punishment answers denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening denial answered within the same sentence by arriving punishment.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence supports the k-f-r and ʿ-dh-b pairing, and both roots are present locally.

topics.headline: hastened punishment reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah reversal: people hasten punishment in 22:47, but here punishment comes to them on its own timing.
topics.reason: The source rows give the concrete same-surah echo and the local syntax makes punishment the arriving subject.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive noun in construct with punishment and modified by the following adjective; a bounded temporal domain
words.root_gloss_range: day, ordinary day, bounded period, occasion, or judgment-time; local construct and adjective select a bounded terminal temporal domain
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) is the hinge of the final phrase: genitive after the punishment noun and the noun modified by the barren adjective, so barrenness locks onto the day rather than directly onto punishment. Its indefiniteness leaves the terminal day unspecified, while its noun role makes it the temporal domain to which punishment belongs, not merely when punishment happens. The unique barren-day pairing marks the phrase beyond ordinary punishment-day language and carries a day-frame forward into the next ayah.

topics.headline: day hinges punishment and barrenness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day connect the punishment above it and the barrenness that modifies it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word both the iḍāfa complement and the noun modified by the adjective.

topics.headline: barrenness locked to the day

topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the genitive indefinite day.

topics.headline: unspecified terminal day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a day, not the day, so the terminal frame remains unspecified until barrenness defines it.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite in construct; possible identifications remain open and should not be forced by this layer.

topics.headline: bounded temporal container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day as a complete temporal container for punishment and barrenness, not merely an adverbial when.
topics.reason: The yawm range includes ordinary day and period, while local genitive noun position makes it the temporal domain to which punishment belongs.

topics.headline: noun role over adverbial day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not reduce the word to when punishment happens; it is the day to which the punishment belongs.
topics.reason: The local iḍāfa slot selects the noun usage.

topics.headline: unique barren-day pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day-plus-barrenness phrase is marked and carries forward into the next ayah's day frame.
topics.reason: The input identifies the pairing as unique and the boundary row notes continuation into the next ayah's temporal frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive qualitative adjective modifying the day: barren, sterile, non-generative
words.root_gloss_range: barrenness, sterility, generative failure across biological, meteorological, temporal, and decree domains; local adjective transfers sterility to time
words.prose: {{ar:عَقِيمٍ}} ({{tr:ʿaqīmin}}) closes the ayah by stamping barrenness onto time itself. The adjective agrees with the day noun, so the phrase is a barren day: not a familiar title, but a qualitative temporal category in which no fruitful continuation is produced. Its rare root maps sterility across divine decree, human biology, wind, and this day (42:50; 51:29; 51:41; 22:55); the unique collocation, final-word position, and run of indefinite endings leave the reader at a no-successor endpoint, opposite the prior guided path (22:54).

topics.headline: barrenness attached to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees barrenness grammatically stamped onto the day as a durable quality.
topics.reason: The adjective is genitive and indefinite in agreement with the day, and its form presents a settled quality.

topics.headline: sterility transferred to time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels time itself described as nonproductive: the day yields no fruit, successor, or recoverable continuation.
topics.reason: The lexical sense of sterility is coherently transferred to the temporal noun that the adjective modifies.

topics.headline: rare root across domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a rare adjective family mapping sterility across woman, wind, divine decree, and day (42:50; 51:29; 51:41; 22:55).
topics.reason: The supplied distribution gives a small cross-domain set, and the local use is the temporal member.

topics.headline: no-successor closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader lands at the final word with a day that produces no next stage after the two arrival clauses.
topics.reason: The final position, metaphorical transfer, and rare adjective converge on terminal closure.

topics.headline: unique barren-day collocation

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 2-6 joins continuing state, disbelief, and being in doubt about it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Continuance keeps the state open, covering keeps the object from view, and doubt supplies the unsettled interior. The result is not a passing question but a maintained epistemic enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The branch's continuance of a state supplies the temporal persistence of the enclosure.
The covering image makes disbelief function as concealment of the disputed object, not mere absence of information.
The doubt-and-hesitation branch supplies the unresolved interior state held inside that covering.

changed_reading.before: They happen to remain uncertain for a time.
changed_reading.after: They continuously inhabit a self-maintaining state in which the object remains covered and therefore unresolved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same continuing construction is coupled to the cross-mapped motion image available for the noun of doubt.
baseline_models.mechanism: A stable duration contains repeated inward movement: they do not settle into one conclusion, but continue to go back and forth. Persistence and instability coexist rather than cancel each other.

activation_trace.role: Movement and disturbance after stillness supply recurrent agitation within the continuing state.
The cross-mapped oscillation and wave image gives the doubt a back-and-forth motion.
The second mapped inventory's continuing-action branch makes oscillation itself the durable condition.

changed_reading.before: Their doubt is a fixed deficit of conviction.
changed_reading.after: Their doubt is durable oscillation: constant motion that never becomes a transition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 9-16 repeat the same arrival root with two subjects: the Hour suddenly, or the punishment of a severe day.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alternatives preserve two coexisting scales of termination, cosmic and historically punitive. Both reverse the prior stasis by making the awaited event reach the doubters, and both converge on harmful arrival.

activation_trace.role: The coming-and-reaching branch binds the two grammatical alternatives into one convergent arrival pattern.
The affliction-and-destruction arrival branch makes the shared verb ominous under both subjects.
Unexpected encounter supplies the discontinuous manner of the Hour's arrival.
Pain and punishment identify the second arrival as an injurious historical or eschatological event.
The day-as-great-event branch lets 'day' denote the severe occurrence, not only a calendar unit.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two loosely synonymous descriptions of the end.
changed_reading.after: It holds open two routes by which suspended doubt can be overtaken: the sudden universal Hour or a punitive event that already has the character of that end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final adjective at word 16 modifies the punitive day through a root whose central images concern failed generation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day does not merely hurt; it terminates productive succession. Womb, wind, and disease branches converge on an event that bears no restorative consequence, carries no fertilizing rain, and admits no cure.

activation_trace.role: The sterile-womb branch supplies failure to generate an offspring or sequel.
The sterile destructive wind supplies force without fertilization, cloud-bearing, or rain.
The incurable-disease branch supplies irreversibility and refusal of repair.
The severe-event branch turns those failures of generation and cure into the quality of an occurrence.

changed_reading.before: A 'barren day' is simply an emphatic label for a bad day.
changed_reading.after: The day is a terminal event: destructive yet non-generative, producing neither future, remedy, nor compensating yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier resurrection argument turns doubt into a sequence of womb formation and dead-earth growth, then states that the Hour is coming. Against that productive chain, the focus verse reprises doubt and arrival but ends with failed generation. The punitive day is the negative image of the evidence the doubters were given.

activation_trace.role: Sterility in the focus supplies the negation of the earlier womb's successful generation.
Agitated doubt explicitly concerns resurrection and supplies an earlier candidate referent for the focus doubt.
The female-womb branch supplies successful containment and generation as the direct foil to barrenness.
Plant emergence from earth supplies visible yield after apparent lifelessness.
The already-announced coming of the Hour supplies the earlier positive statement later recast as arrival upon the doubters.

structural_cues: 22:5 moves from doubt through gestation to an earth that grows every delightful pair.
22:7 and 22:55 repeat Hour plus arrival, but 22:55 adds persistent doubt and a barren alternative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection-doubt, womb and plant fertility, and the announced coming Hour; I infer that the focus ending deliberately inverts that productive sequence. The nearer signs-and-recitation referent for 'it' remains live rather than being displaced.

changed_reading.before: The barren day is an isolated image of punishment.
changed_reading.after: It is the anti-resurrection image within the surah's own material sequence: those who resist evidence of renewed generation meet an event that generates nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier summons makes people and mounts come from deep routes toward a witnessed center. The focus repeats the arrival root twice but reverses agency: the Hour or punishment now comes to them. Voluntary convergence becomes involuntary encounter.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses coming and reaching for two events whose endpoint is the doubters themselves.
The same coming branch depicts summoned humans and mounts converging by their own journey, supplying the reversible spatial pattern.

structural_cues: The subjects of coming change from pilgrims and mounts in 22:27 to the Hour and punishment in 22:55.
The endpoint changes from 'to you' to 'to them.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated arrival lexeme and opposite participant structures; I infer a reversal from chosen approach to being approached. The two passages need not describe the same journey for the spatial reversal to remain active.

changed_reading.before: Coming in the focus only marks future occurrence.
changed_reading.after: Coming also reverses the surah's earlier pilgrimage geometry: those who do not approach the sign become the destination of what they refused to meet.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated extension of time is followed by seizure, while the addressees demand acceleration and a divine day exceeds their count. Long apparent non-occurrence habituates them to continuation; seizure then breaks that expectation at once. Suddenness describes experienced discontinuity after reprieve, not absence of prior warning.

activation_trace.role: Unexpected encounter supplies the focus's abrupt experiential break.
Extended time and respite supply the long interval in which non-arrival can be mistaken for safety.
Taking to account for wrongdoing supplies the decisive termination that follows respite.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the doubters' demand that punishment conform to their clock.
A promise fixed to time or place supplies an appointed event even when its measure is hidden.
The flexible duration branch permits divine and human measures of a day to diverge.
The second mapped root's granting of extra duration confirms that delay is active reprieve rather than failed arrival.
The repeated taking for wrongdoing closes the second respite sequence and establishes the pattern.

structural_cues: 22:44 and 22:48 repeat respite followed by taking.
22:47 places demanded haste beside a day measured as a thousand counted years.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reprieve-then-taking, demanded haste, and unequal temporal measure; I infer that prolonged delay produces the expectation whose collapse is felt as sudden. A literally instantaneous Hour remains a compatible reading.

changed_reading.before: Sudden means that the event has no temporal preparation.
changed_reading.after: Sudden means that a fully warned and appointed event can still rupture a long, misleading experience of reprieve without transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding opponents move purposefully against the signs in an attempt to outstrip or escape them. The focus answers that directed race with two events that reach the racers. Persistence in doubt is therefore active evasive motion, and arrival is overtaking.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing motion and agitation allow persistence to contain active evasive movement.
Coming and reaching make the Hour or punishment the agent that closes the distance.
Competitive striving supplies the opponents' active race against the signs.
Escaping by getting ahead supplies the attempted outstripping that the focus arrivals reverse.

structural_cues: 22:51 gives the opponents purposeful motion against the signs; 22:55 gives the Hour and punishment motion toward them.
The focus repeats the same disbelieving group while reversing who closes the distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competitive striving, attempted escape, and later arrival upon the same class; I infer an overtaking relation. The movement may be rhetorical opposition rather than a literal chase, so the spatial mechanism remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: They wait passively in doubt until an event happens.
changed_reading.after: Their doubt includes an effort to outrun the signs, while the two arrivals depict the limit that overtakes that effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence presents intrusive casting, removal with replacement, securing of signs, and an assay that yields opposite heart responses. The focus doubt is thus not generic ignorance after an untouched message; it persists after a contested transmission has been separated and made firm. The pronoun can remain live across the confirmed signs, the truth they disclose, and the cast material functioning as trial.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and hesitation supply the unresolved response to the immediately preceding process.
Sharp verbal disputation keeps open the possibility that doubt is publicly argued, not only privately felt.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive material that enters the recitation sequence.
Removal followed by replacement supplies active differentiation rather than simple erasure into a void.
Making firm, exact, and secure supplies the stabilized signs that remain after differentiation.
Testing metal or persons turns the intrusive material into an assay that reveals recipient condition.
Loss of heart-softness supplies one resistant result of the assay.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the truth recognized by the contrasting recipients.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, removal, and securing before 22:53 names the cast material a trial.
22:53-54 split heart responses to the same sequence, after which 22:55 says the disbelievers remain in doubt 'about it.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a differentiated textual process and opposed recipient outcomes; I infer that the focus pronoun deliberately carries that contested field forward. Its referent may be the secured revelation, its truth, the cast trial, or the wider sign-event, and the trace does not force one antecedent.

changed_reading.before: The pronoun has one settled generic referent, and the group merely lacks certainty about it.
changed_reading.after: The pronoun preserves a live referential field after textual assay, while their doubt is the resistant outcome of a process that softens other hearts into recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rare sterility branch images a ruler before whom kinship no longer protects. The next verse announces undivided sovereignty and judgment between groups, then assigns humiliating punishment. This activates barrenness as relational cutoff: inherited ties and prior standing generate no exemption at adjudication.

activation_trace.role: The king-who-cuts-kinship image supplies a form-distant model of sovereignty overriding protective lineage.
Day as a great event carries the relational cutoff into the focus occurrence.
Sovereignty supplies the explicit context trigger for the focus root's otherwise distant royal branch.
Judgment between people gives the sovereignty a sorting function rather than mere possession.
Blocking the truth identifies the group carried from focus doubt into the judgment outcome.
Painful punishment makes the focus's alternative arrival explicit immediately after judgment.
Humiliation through being treated as slight removes the status that might otherwise function as protection.

structural_cues: The focus's 'day barren' is followed immediately by 'sovereignty that day' and judgment between them.
22:56-57 sort the two groups into opposed outcomes rather than continuing the prior uncertainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the royal sterility branch, then sovereignty, judgment, and group-specific outcome; I infer only the severance of ordinary protective ties. The branch's image of a human ruler's violence must not be transferred wholesale to divine sovereignty, and ordinary non-generativity remains the stronger sense.

changed_reading.before: Barrenness concerns only the day's lack of productive aftermath.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day is also barren of inherited protection: sovereignty judges between groups without kinship or status generating an escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later rainfall reaches earth and produces green growth. The focus root's sterile-wind branch names the exact material inverse: a force that neither fertilizes tree nor cloud nor carries rain, and instead destroys. The barren day is an incoming anti-rain event.

activation_trace.role: The sterile destructive wind supplies incoming force without fertilization or rain.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the beneficial incoming movement opposed to the focus event.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring supplies the medium of productive arrival.
Tender green vegetation supplies the visible yield that sterility withholds.

structural_cues: 22:63 compresses descent, water, and immediate greening into one causal sequence.
The focus alternative likewise has an event come, but its final modifier reverses the productive result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive descent and a focus branch explicitly defined by non-fertilizing, rainless destructive wind; I infer a material inversion between the two arrivals. The focus need not literally identify the punishment with wind.

changed_reading.before: The adjective only says that the punitive day has no offspring.
changed_reading.after: The day can also be sensed as an anti-rain: force arrives, but instead of turning earth green it closes every channel of yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky is actively held from falling on earth except by permission. Read back into the focus, sudden arrival need not be random or ungoverned; it is abrupt at the receiver's level because a prior restraint ceases at an authorized threshold.

activation_trace.role: Unexpected encounter supplies the receiver's experience of abrupt release.
Coming and reaching supply the movement that follows the inferred release.
Holding and confining supply an active restraint before catastrophe.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the restrained downward event.
Permission supplies the threshold at which restraint may give way to occurrence.

structural_cues: 22:65 states a held catastrophic possibility and an explicit exception by permission.
The focus marks the Hour's arrival as sudden from the perspective of those it reaches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, possible falling, and permission; I supply the arrow from permission to release and from release to experienced suddenness. The sky-fall need not be identical with the Hour, so this remains a structural analogy.

changed_reading.before: Suddenness suggests an event without prior structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, suddenness is the visible instant when an already governed restraint is released, making cosmic order and abrupt arrival compatible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the milking/extraction branch of the doubt root with growth-yield in the arrival root and sterility in the final adjective. All three are anchored in focus words, so the mechanism is worth retaining, but downstream prose should mark it as a cross-domain lexical experiment rather than replace the ordinary senses of doubt, arrival, and barrenness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence moves from the noun at word 6 through repeated arrival at words 9 and 13 to sterile at word 16.

activation_trace.role: Rubbing or milking to draw out a yield makes doubt an extractive handling of the disputed object.
Emergent growth and produce supply the yield that an arrival might otherwise bring.
Sterility denies offspring to the repeated extraction and expected yield.

changed_reading.before: Doubt is simply possessed until an unrelated punishment arrives.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they keep pressing the matter for a yield, but the only yield that reaches them is a day defined by producing none.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it scales reproductive barrenness into civic infrastructure. The abandoned well, emptied settlement, and focus sterile-wind branch provide a visible packet-backed mechanism, but prose should present them as a material analogy for a day without social continuation, not claim that 22:55 directly names the ruins of 22:45.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective at word 16 can carry the sterile-wind image of no rain or fertilization into an earlier scene of emptied habitation.

activation_trace.role: The rainless destructive wind supplies ecological barrenness in the focus.
Emptiness supplies habitation whose human contents and continuity have vanished.
The excavated well supplies a surviving source structure that would ordinarily sustain communal life.
Vacancy and disablement make the water source present yet nonfunctional, a civic analogue of sterility.

changed_reading.before: A barren day affects only those punished within its duration.
changed_reading.after: It can leave a whole life-support system unable to reproduce communal life: structures remain, but their sustaining use has ended.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats day and night succession as a generative relation and reads barrenness temporally. It remains anchored in the focus day-plus-sterile construction and the packet's mutual-entry branch, but prose should qualify it as a structural analogy, not a claim that ordinary chronology literally stops.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 15-16 join a duration/event noun to failed generation, while 22:61 supplies the surah's ordinary model of one temporal phase entering the other.

activation_trace.role: Day as a duration supplies the temporal unit whose succession is being tested.
Failure to generate offspring supplies the analogy of a duration that produces no successor.
One thing entering another supplies the normal mutual transition of night and day that the barren-day image interrupts.

changed_reading.before: The punitive day is one severe interval followed by another phase.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a day that does not beget a next phase for those it encloses, unlike the ordinary reciprocal entry of night and day.

strongest_changes: The barren day becomes the material inverse of the surah's womb, plant, and rain sequences: arrival without generation, greening, or repair.
Suddenness becomes the collapse of expectation after extended reprieve, while remaining compatible with appointment and warning.
The immediate casting-removal-securing sequence makes doubt a resistant outcome after textual assay and keeps several antecedents of 'it' coexisting.
Earlier chosen arrival and attempted outstripping are reversed when the Hour or punishment makes the doubters its destination.
The royal branch of sterility, activated by the next verse's sovereignty and judgment, tentatively adds a cutoff of inherited protection.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse concentrates durable instability, reversed arrival, and failed generation into one sentence. Context does not settle it into a single eschatological gloss: resurrection, revelation under assay, historical seizure, cosmic release, judicial sorting, and material barrenness remain distinct but traceable readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of 'it' remains live among the secured signs or revelation, their truth, the cast trial, resurrection, and the threatened event.
The two arrivals may distinguish the universal Hour from a nearer punitive day, or may be parallel views of one terminal event.
The sovereignty and temporal-successor readings depend on rare or cross-domain branches and require explicit qualification.
The held-sky sequence supports an authorized-release mechanism structurally, but does not identify sky-fall with the Hour.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Continuing doubt is terminated by unanticipated arrival.** `ز ي ل B003` marks continuance in *mā zāla*; `م ر ي B004/B003` doubt and contentious disputing; `ء ت ي B001` arrival; `ب غ ت B001` sudden unexpectedness. The durative state runs until a sharp temporal boundary. I infer that cultivated hesitation becomes a holding environment whose only decisive exit is the event it postpones. Doubt reads as sustained occupation, not a passing question.
2. **A sterile day produces no further possibility.** `ع ق م B001/B003` is sterility and blocked joints; `ي و م B003` a severe event-day; `ع ذ ب B005` punishment. I infer that this day is “sterile” because no new response, lineage of action, or escape-route can issue from it. The alternative to the sudden Hour reads as an event whose consequence cannot generate a future beyond itself.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:66's life → death → life sequence sharpened the sterile-day image: divine renewal is real, but this event is sterile for those who maintained refusal until arrival.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sustained hesitation is terminated by irreversible arrival.** Fixed `لَا يَزَال` activates `ز ي ل:B003` (continuance in the formula), `مِرْيَة` activates `م ر ي:B004` (doubt and hesitation), repeated `تَأْتِي` uses `ء ت ي:B001` (arrival), and `بَغْتَة` activates `ب غ ت:B001` (unexpected suddenness). `22:52-54` supplied correction, firm signs, and a route to assent; the fixed subjects instead maintain the unresolved state until the event acts on them. I infer that delay is being used to preserve hesitation, while arrival removes the option of further suspension. The ayah reads doubt as a maintained temporal posture.
2. **The sterile day has no productive sequel.** Fixed `عَقِيم` activates `ع ق م:B001` (sterility in womb and offspring). `22:56` contrasts gardens of well-being and `22:58-59` good provision and a pleasing entry. The packet supplies sterility beside generative outcomes; I infer that this event-day produces no future branch through which its sufferers can escape or repair. “Sterile” reads temporally and causally, not merely as severe.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:56-59` sharpen “sterile” by contrast: garden well-being, good provision, and satisfying entry all generate continuation, while the fixed day closes every productive sequel.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bulunduğu yerden ya da içinde bulunduğu konumdan ayrılması veya bir başkasının onu bu yer ya da konumdan uzaklaştırmasıdır. Güneşin tepe noktasından kayması ve iktidarın elden gitmesi bu değişimin özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık bulunduğu yerden ya da izlediği konumdan ayrılır.
Bir kişi ya da etken, başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden veya konumdan uzaklaştırır.
Güneşin tepe noktasından kayması ve iktidarın sahibinden çıkması, ayrılma çekirdeğinin özel bağlamlarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, kendiliğinden ayrılma ile ettirgen uzaklaştırmayı bir arada verir; yer, izlenen konum, güneş ve iktidar bağlamları bu çerçevede birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: yer veya konumdan ayrılma ve ayırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kendiliğinden gerçekleşen ayrılma çekirdeğini, ettirgen uzaklaştırmayı ve bunların özel bağlamlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yer ya da konum değişimini ve bu değişimi başkasına yaptırma ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin ya da topluluğun bulunduğu yerden kendiliğinden çekilmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kendiliğinden gerçekleşen yer değişimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ettirgen uzaklaştırmayı ve durum değişimine dayalı özel kullanımları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir etkenin başka bir şeyi yerinden ya da içinde bulunduğu konumdan uzaklaştırdığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen uzaklaştırma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendiliğinden ayrılmayı ve güneş ile iktidara özgü gerçekleşmeleri kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda güneşin göğün orta noktasından ayrılması daha merkezî ve sınır daha dardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: تنحي الشيء عن مكانه؛ زال الشيء زوالا؛ أزلته عن المكان وزولته عنه (maqayis)؛ والزوال ذهاب الملك؛ زوال الشمس (ayn)؛ زال الشيء من مكانه يزول زوالا وأزاله غيره وزوله (sihah)؛ زال القوم عن مكانهم إذا حاصوا عنه وتنحوا؛ لا يستطيع من منزلة زويلا ولا حويلا (tahdhib)؛ زال الشيء يزول زوالا فارق طريقته جانحا عنه؛ أزلته وزولته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yalnızca durgunluktan sonraki tek bir hareketi değil, hareketli olmayı, yerinde duramamayı, yürürken çok kıpırdamayı ve kaygıyla oluşan çırpınmayı birlikte bildirir. Bu nedenle geçici hareket ile sürekli hareketlilik aynı çekirdeğin ayrı görünümleri olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, amaçlı biçimde bir yerden ayrılmayı ya da bir şeyi yerinden uzaklaştırmayı değil, hareket ve yerinde duramama görünümünü anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel hareket çekirdeğini korur; atların hareketi ile ağlama ve kaygıya bağlı çırpınma yalnızca kendi söz çevrelerinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin durağan kalmayıp hareket etmesi, canlı bir varlığın yerinde durmaması ya da bir kişinin yürüyüşünde sık sık kıpırdamasıdır. Ağlama ve kaygıyla beliren huzursuz hareket bunun duyguya bağlı özel bir kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık durağan kalmaz, hareket eder ya da bulunduğu yerde durmaz.
Yürüyüş sırasında çok kıpırdanma, hareket çekirdeğinin kişiye özgü bir görünümüdür.
Ağlama ve kaygının doğurduğu huzursuzluk, hareket ve çırpınmayla birlikte anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, hareket etme ve yerinde duramama çekirdeğini canlılar, atlar, görünen bir biçim, yürüyüş ve kaygılı çırpınma üzerinden genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel hareketi, sürekli kıpırdanmayı ve duyguya bağlı huzursuz hareketi ortak çekirdekte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Durağan kalmama ve hareket etme ortaklığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce durağan görünen bir şeyde hareket belirdiğini anlatan yalın bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Durağanlıktan harekete geçişi korur.
error_profile.loses: Sürekli yerinde duramamayı ve kaygıya bağlı çırpınmayı kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaygı, ağlama ya da iç sıkıntısıyla ortaya çıkan hareket için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Duyguya bağlı huzursuz hareketi korur.
error_profile.loses: Duygusal neden taşımayan genel hareketi kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yerinde durmayan hareketli canlı ya da şey

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, canlı bir varlığın yerinde durmamasını, yürüyüşte çok kıpırdamayı ve kaygılı hareketi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, darbe alanın sarsılmasını, kalabalık bir birliğin dalgalanmasını ve baş gibi bir bölümün hareketini ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da durağanlığın bozulması, hareket ve gözle görülür kıpırdanma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hareketli olma ve yerinde duramama çevresinde kurulur; komşu dal ise sarsılma, dalgalanma ve çalkantı türlerini daha geniş bir olay alanında toplar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel hareket ve çalkantı çekirdeğiyle en belirgin örtüşmeyi kuran komşu, kapsam ayrımıyla birlikte yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الزائلة لكل متحرك، والحيوان الذي لا يقر، وحركة الشبح، والقلق والفزع والحركة

branches.source_phrase_ar: الزائلة كل شيء يتحرك (maqayis)؛ زالت الخيل بركبانها زوالا (ayn)؛ الزوال الذي يتحرك في مشيته كثيرا؛ الزائلة كل شيء يتحرك (sihah)؛ الزول الحركة؛ رأيت شبحا ثم زال أي تحرك؛ الزائلة كل ذي روح من الحيوان يزول عن موضعه ولا يقر في مكانه؛ أخذه البكاء والقلق والحركة (tahdhib)؛ الزوال التصرف؛ أذهب الله حركتها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir şeyi ele alıp onunla uğraşma, onu yapmaya çalışma ve karşılıklı biçimde birbirini zorlama anlamlarını açıkça ortaklaştırır. Dal çerçevesi bu işlem ve çaba çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki çekirdek yalnızca hareket etmek ya da yer değiştirmek değil, bir işi veya kişiyi etkin biçimde ele alıp sonuç almaya çalışmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım uğraşma çekirdeğini verir; bir gereksinimle uğraşma ve kişiler arası çekişme yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlı alt kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi etkin biçimde ele alıp onunla uğraşmak, onu gerçekleştirmeye çalışmak veya bir kişiyle bir iş üzerinde karşılıklı olarak çekişmektir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi bir şeyi ele alır, onunla uğraşır ve onu gerçekleştirmeye çalışır.
Uğraşma karşılıklı olduğunda taraflar bir iş üzerinde birbirini zorlar ya da birbirine üstün gelmeye çalışır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uğraşma, deneme ve ele alma anlamlarında birleşir; gereksinimi giderme çabası ile kişiler arası çekişme bu çekirdeğin bağlamsal uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi ele alıp onunla uğraşma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işi yapmaya çalışma ile karşılıklı çekişmenin paylaştığı etkin uğraşma çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Etkin biçimde ele alma, uğraşma ve sonuç almaya çalışma bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin, gereksinimin ya da nesnenin ele alınıp yapılmaya çalışıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uğraşma ve gerçekleştirmeye çalışma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişiler arasındaki karşılıklı çekişmeyi açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın bir iş üzerinde birbirini zorladığı veya üstün gelmeye çalıştığı karşılıklı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı uğraşma ve üstün gelme çabasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek kişinin bir işi ele alıp gerçekleştirmeye çalışmasını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi ele alıp onunla uğraşma ve onu deneme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sıradan bir denemeyi ve kişiler arasındaki karşılıklı çekişmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda uğraşın yoğun ve güçlükle yürütülmesi kurucu bir sınırdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bir şeyi işleyip sonuç almaya çalışma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi etkin biçimde ele almayı ve sonuç almak için onunla uğraşmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uğraşın şiddetli olmasını gerektirmez ve deneme ile karşılıklı çekişmeye açılır; komşu dal ise yoğun ve güç bir işleme çabasını merkezine alır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المزاولة المعالجة في الأشياء (ayn)؛ المزاولة مثل المحاولة والمعالجة؛ تزاولوا تعالجوا؛ يزاولنا عن نفسه ونزاوله (sihah)؛ المزاولة معالجة الرجل الشيء ومحاولته؛ فلان يزاول حاجة له؛ زاولته مزاولة إذا عالجته (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu küme tek bir kavram değildir: yaygın kişi nitelemesi çevik, zarif ya da becerikli kişiyi anlatırken aynı ses biçimi şahin, erkeklik organı, yiğit kişi ve cömert kişi için de ayrı ad olarak verilmiştir.

facets.statement: İnsan için kullanılan ana niteleme çeviklik, zariflik ve beceriklilik özelliklerini birleştirir.
Kadın için gözü açık, iş bitirici ya da toplum içinde görünür olma nitelikleri ayrıca verilir.
Şahin ve erkeklik organı aynı biçimin kişi nitelemesiyle kavramsal bağ kurmayan ayrı adlandırmalarıdır.
Yiğit ve cömert kişi anlamları da ana çeviklik ve zariflik nitelemesinden ayrı değerlendirilmelidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın özel, yalıtık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek tek kullanımların özel göndergelerini kavram karşılığının içine ayrı ayrı taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkek ya da genç için çeviklik ile zarifliği birlikte öne çıkaran kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi nitelemesindeki çeviklik ve zarifliği korur.
error_profile.loses: Kadına özgü beceriklilik görünümünü ve ayrı adlandırmaları kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.text: gözü açık ve iş bitirici kadın
contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının çevik, becerikli ve işlerini etkili biçimde yürüten biri olarak nitelendiği kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına yüklenen beceriklilik ve ataklık özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel erkek nitelemesini ve kişi dışındaki ayrı adlandırmaları kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü hem şaşkınlık uyandıran niteliği hem de bu niteliği taşıyan şeyi bildirir. Dal çerçevesi, soyut şaşkınlık ile şaşırtıcı nesne arasındaki düzenli geçişi doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal çevik veya zarif kişi nitelemesini değil, alışılmışın dışında oluşuyla şaşkınlık uyandıran niteliği ya da şeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım soyut şaşırtıcılık ile bir şeyi şaşırtıcı diye niteleyen söz öbeğini ayırır; söz öbeğine özgü niteleme yalın kullanımın tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin alışılmışın dışında oluşuyla şaşkınlık uyandırması veya bu niteliği taşıyan şaşırtıcı şeydir.

facets.statement: Alışılmışın dışındaki bir nitelik kişide şaşkınlık uyandırır.
Şaşkınlık uyandıran nitelik, bu niteliği taşıyan şeyin adı ya da sıfatı olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak kanıtı şaşkınlık uyandıran niteliği ve bu niteliği taşıyan şeyi birlikte verir; içerikte kaynaklar arası belirgin bir ayrım yoktur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem şaşırtıcı niteliği hem de bu niteliği taşıyan şeyi kapsayan en kısa ortak karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Olağan dışı olma ile şaşkınlık uyandırma bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin alışılmadık niteliğini doğrudan belirten niteleme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Soyut şaşkınlık adını açıkça karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için şaşkınlık uyandırmak yeterlidir; komşu dal ise şaşırtıcılığı daha önce görülmemiş veya yeni olma koşuluyla birleştirir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: شيء زول أي عجب (maqayis)؛ الزول العجب (sihah)؛ الزول العجب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü tek bir korku kavramı sunmaz; belirli kalıplarda korkuyla sarsılma, kişinin içindekinin sonuna kadar açığa çıkması, yok oluş dileği ve görüntü ya da hareketin ortadan kalkması gibi ayrışan yorumlar verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak ortak bir yalın anlam gibi değil, birden çok kalıba bağlı kullanım kümesi olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlamlar yalnızca kanıtta verilen kalıplara bağlıdır; bunlardan genel bir yer değiştirme, korku ya da açığa çıkarma anlamı türetilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle kalıba bağlıdır ve korku, içindekini açığa vurma, yok oluş dileği ve ortadan kalkma yorumlarını yalın kök anlamı olarak genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıp sözlerde bir kişinin korkuyla sarsılması ya da içindekini bütünüyle açığa vurması anlatılır. Başka bir kalıp ise yok olup gitme dileği veya bir görüntü ya da hareketin ortadan kalkması biçiminde yorumlanır.

facets.statement: Kalıba bağlı bir kullanım, korkunun kişiyi sarsmasını ya da iç dünyasındaki şeyi açığa çıkarmasını anlatır.
Başka bir kalıp, bir kişi için yok olup gitme dileği bildiren söz olarak yorumlanır.
Aynı söz çevresi, bir görüntünün ya da hareketin ortadan kalkması biçiminde de açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, kalıpları korkuyla sarsılma ve içindekini açığa çıkarma çevresinde toplarken başka yorumlarda yok oluş dileği ile görüntü veya hareketin ortadan kalkmasını da korur.

concept_gloss.text: kalıba göre sarsılma, açığa vurma ya da ortadan kalkma
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca bu dalda kanıtlanan kalıp sözlerin ayrışan yorumlarını topluca göstermek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuyla sarsılma, içindekini açığa vurma ve ortadan kalkma ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıbın kişide korku ve iç sarsıntısı oluştuğunu bildiren yorumunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkunun kişide oluşturduğu sarsıntıyı korur.
error_profile.loses: İçindekini açığa vurma, yok oluş dileği ve ortadan kalkma yorumlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin içinde saklı olanı sonuna kadar ortaya koyduğu biçiminde açıklanan kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İçte saklı olanın açığa çıkması yorumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Korkuyla sarsılma, yok oluş dileği ve hareketin ortadan kalkması yorumlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: korkuya kapılmak ya da içindekini bütünüyle açığa vurmak
yok olup gitsin; görüntüsü ya da hareketi ortadan kalktı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal korkuyu yalnızca belirli bir kalıpta verir ve içindekini açığa vurma ile yok oluş yorumlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal korkunun doğrudan kalpte oluşmasını ve güçlü ürküntüyü bağımsız kavram olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da korkunun kişide güçlü bir iç sarsıntısı oluşturması bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın korku anlamı belirli bir söz kalıbına ve başka yorumlarla birlikte yaşamaya bağlıdır; komşu dal ise korkunun kendisini doğrudan merkezine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal açığa çıkmayı kişinin içindekinin sonuna kadar ortaya dökülmesi biçiminde ve belirli bir kalıpta anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal açık alanı, görünürlüğü, açıklığı ve karşılıklı açık konuşmayı daha geniş bir alanda kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da daha önce saklı olan bir içeriğin görünür ya da bilinir duruma gelmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kullanım kişide saklı içeriğin kalıba bağlı biçimde açığa vurulmasıdır; komşu kullanım ise açıklık ve görünürlüğü kişi içeriğiyle sınırlamadan anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; dalın iki temel karışma noktasını, korku ve gizlinin açığa çıkmasını, doğrudan aydınlatan iki komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه زيل زويله وزواله من الذعر، وبلغ مكنون نفسه، وزال زواله في الدعاء عليه أو زوال خياله
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الزوال عن المكان

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir şeyi başka bir şeyden ayırma, aralarını bölme ve öğeleri birbirinden seçilir kılma anlamlarını ortaklaştırır. Bununla birlikte kaynak, bu biçimlerin kök kimliğini odak kökten ayırdığı için dal, kanıtlanan ayırma çekirdeğiyle fakat kök kimliği uyarısı korunarak okunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel yer değiştirme ya da uğraşma anlamı değildir; sınırı ayırma, bölme ve birbirinden seçilir duruma getirme kullanımlarıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kanıtlanan kavram, bir şeyi başka bir şeyden ayırmak, topluluğu bölmek ya da öğeleri birbirinden seçilir duruma getirmektir; ancak kaynak bunu açıkça başka bir kök yapısına bağlar.

facets.statement: Bir şey başka bir şeyden ayrılır veya bir etken iki şeyi birbirinden ayırır.
Ayırma işlemi, bir topluluğu bölme ve öğeleri birbirinden seçilir duruma getirme biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Kaynak, bu biçimlerin kök kimliğini odak kökten ayırarak başka bir kök yapısına verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, ayırma, topluluğu bölme ve öğeleri birbirinden seçilir kılma anlamlarında birleşir; kaynakların kök kimliği uyarısı bu çekirdeğin yanında korunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıtlanan ayırma, bölme ve öğeleri birbirinden seçilir kılma çekirdeğini karşılar; kök kimliği uyarısı anlamın kapsamını genişletmez.

error_profile.preserves: Ayırma, bölme ve birbirinden seçilir kılma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki şeyin veya bir topluluğun parçalarının birbirinden ayrıldığı kullanım alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ayırma ve ayrışma işleminin temel yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda ayırma çekirdeği, kaynakların kök kimliğini odak kökten ayıran uyarısıyla birlikte verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, ayırma ve temyiz çekirdeğini kendi kök alanı içinde daha üretken biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da şeylerin ya da topluluk öğelerinin birbirinden ayrılması ve seçilir duruma gelmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aynı ayırma alanını taşır, fakat kanıtta kök kimliği uyarısıyla sınırlanır; komşu dalda bu sınır uyarısı yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; ayırma ve temyiz çekirdeğini doğrudan paylaşan komşu, kök kimliği sınırı belirtilerek yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه زال الشيء من الشيء يزيله زيلا، وتزيلوا، وفزيلنا بينهم، وفرقت ذا من ذا وأبنت ذا من ذا

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, olumsuzluk öğesiyle kurulan belirli yapılarda bir eylemin, haberin ya da durumun sürmesini açıkça ortak anlam olarak verir. Dal çerçevesi bu sürekliliği ve yapısal koşulu doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yerden ayrılma anlamı taşımaz ve olumlu, yalın bir eylem olarak kullanılamaz; süreklilik olumsuzluk öğeli yapıya bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca olumsuzluk öğesiyle kurulan ve eylem ya da durumun sürdüğünü bildiren lexical yapıları kapsar; yalın kök anlamı önermez.

concept_map.definition: Olumsuzluk öğesiyle kurulan belirli yapılarda bir eylemin yapılmayı, bir durumun var olmayı ya da bir haberin geçerli kalmayı sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Olumsuzluk öğeli yapı, eylem veya durumun kesilmeden sürdüğünü bildirir.
Yapı, özne ile süren durum veya haberi birbirine bağlayan yardımcı bir görev üstlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar olumsuzluk öğesi zorunluluğu ile eylem, durum veya haberin sürmesi konusunda birleşir; yapı özneyle süren niteliği bağlayan yardımcı görev de görür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Olumsuzluk öğeli yapının eylem, durum ve haber sürekliliğini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem veya durumun kesilmeden sürmesi çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eylem ya da durumun konuşma anına veya belirtilen zamana dek sürdüğü doğal cümle çevirilerinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem ve durumun sürmekte oluşunu doğal Türkçe içinde korur.
